description: Kernel-mystery probe: Excel's tiny-x erf on mantissas M0 + n*2^36 (n = 0..2047, M0 = 4660892420333017), x = M*2^-92. The stride turns a hidden intermediate rounding into a periodic pattern at frequency frac(m*2^36), so a set of strides recovers the hidden constant's bits. B = ERF.PRECISE(x).
